title: Do you guys enjoy being involved in the very start of games and play the alpha playtests?
author: AetherianChronicles
selftext: We often need more games to play over time, we have loads of developers ( solo, big/small teams, etc. ) who love building games and creating new worlds with their hearts but they extremely need our support, especially with solo/small teams of developers, we have great developers working tirelessly to create awesome games and what can we do to help them? Getting involved in playtests is a huge help, offering them our feedback. They want to listen to you and improve their games based on the opinion of who is most important to them: the players. I wanted to know how many people enjoy the alpha playtests, do you have fun discovering and testing new games?

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
